 (BY SHRI RAJMANI SINGROUL - ADVOCATE )

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH P.S.
 DEVENDRANAGAR DISTRICT PANNA (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY MRS. RANJANA AGNIHOTRI - DY. GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.9/2023, registered at P.S.- Devendranagar,
District- Panna (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(f) and 506 of IPC.
He is in detention since 13.1.2023.

As per the prosecution story, on 12.1.2023 prosecutrix lodged an FIR against present applicant that on 3.1.2023 in the night, applicant, who is her relative committed rape upon her and threatened to do death, if she discloses the incident to anyone.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
FIR has been lodged after an inordinate delay of 10 days.
No incident as has been alleged had taken place.
He has been implicated only due to enmity.

sentences.text: Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant/accused be released on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State as well as the counsel for the objector have opposed the grant of bail to the present applicant.
In this case FIR has been lodged after 10 days.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed.
Applicant and prosecutrix both are major.

Therefore, having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merit of the case, I am of the view t h a t it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the present applicants/accused is not warranted.
Consequently, second bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

It is directed that applicant- Mathura Pd. Patel be released on bail on h is furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction o f the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Mathura Prasad Patel vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25499354/
